subject: UniProtKB:Q52154
description: This edge records PcaR-dependent pcaIJ gene expression. A separate binding assay used the full pHS104 construct; Methods names Escherichia coli K38, while Figure 6 names DH5alpha. The truncated pHS105 control did not bind; these binding preparations are not assigned the separate gene-expression result. Beta-ketoadipate did not change complex migration (data not shown), so direct ligand binding is not asserted. The exact deposited Q52154/L33795 sequence leaves the native initiator uncertain among Met-1, Met-23 and Met-45.
